summary: Implemented the journal layer under apps/agent-server/src/memory/ (normalize, store, recorder) with vitest coverage, and changed session-repository.ts delete() to move transcripts into ~/.gizmo/sessions/archived/ instead of removing them. All 145 tests pass, typecheck is clean, and prettier is clean on the touched files.
decisions: Delete action is implemented as archive, not removal: transcripts are renamed into ~/.gizmo/sessions/archived/ and attachments are moved alongside. SessionManager.listAll reads its directory non-recursively, so archived sessions naturally drop out of the catalog and open() — no filtering required.

Journal normalization preserves user/assistant prose verbatim; reasoning, tool arguments, and successful tool results get head+tail truncation with a dropped-char count, but tool errors are kept whole because errors are usually short and explain later decisions.

JournalStore writes the segment file (tmp+rename) before its index.jsonl line, so a crash mid-append leaves an unreferenced segment rather than a dangling index entry — the recoverable direction. A torn final index line is skipped rather than thrown.

record(session, { trigger, until }) takes an explicit until boundary so the compaction case can pass firstKeptEntryId and the segment ends exactly where live context resumes, preventing kept messages from being journaled twice.
No model calls anywhere in the journal layer; it must keep working when extraction is unavailable, which is why journaling and the later facts layer are kept separate.

Archive storage is global (~/.gizmo/sessions/archived/) because Pi keys sessions by id, not project; the journal is per-project (<project>/.gizmo/memory/journal/) because knowledge is scoped to the project.
ReadonlySessionManager is replaced with a local structural type in journal-recorder because Pi's type is not re-exported from the package root.

The recorder is not yet wired to any hook (session_compact, turn_end, session_shutdown); that is left pending the user's decision on whether memory is bundled into every session via pi-session-factory's additionalExtensionPaths or made per-project-toggleable via ProjectCatalog.disabledPiExtensionsFor(cwd).
errors: Initial recorder build failed typecheck because ReadonlySessionManager is not re-exported from @earendil-works/pi-coding-agent's package root; resolved by replacing it with a local structural type the recorder actually needs.
pnpm check:loc failed with '7 file(s) exceed the 300-line limit', confirmed pre-existing on a clean tree and not caused by this work.

pnpm format:check failed repository-wide after prettier --write ran, but only because of pre-existing files outside the touched set; the new memory files and edited session-repository files are clean.
